anchor.rule: token embedding = anchor.emb (frozen); logits = (rmsnorm(x) * anchor.readout_gain) @ anchor.emb^T (tied, both frozen)

norm: RMSNorm (default eps) with gain fixed at 1 at every cell input (attention and MLP); the readout uses the anchor's frozen readout_gain

cell.adapters: u = h + bin(ain h) on input; o' = o + bout(aout o) on output; low rank
cell.free: n_head, mlp, rank are free (host pads smaller organs exactly); head_dim fixed
